leads.title: Criminal Act of 1991, Article 148 (as amended 2009)
leads.documents: Defines sodomy as anal sex illegal in Sudan whether same-sex or opposite-sex; legal basis for criminalization and prior capital/corporal punishment

leads.documents: Abolished death penalty and 100 lashes for anal sex; retained criminalization with up to 5 years first offence, up to 7 years second offence, life imprisonment third offence; hailed by activists as first step

leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2011 Human Rights Report on Sudan
leads.documents: Documents law prohibits sodomy but no reports of antisodomy laws being applied; no known LGBT organizations; official discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity; widespread societal discrimination; vigilantes targeted suspected gay men and lesbians for violent abuse and public demonstrations against homosexuality
